name: open-user-man
description: Open User Man (oum) — user, group, and permission management with REST and gRPC

scripts.compose:up: OUM_DATABASE_KIND=postgres OUM_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://oum:oum@postgres:5432/open_user_db docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile postgres up --build
scripts.compose:up:mssql: OUM_DATABASE_KIND=mssql OUM_DATABASE_URL=mssql://oum:oum@mssql:1433/open_user_db docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile mssql up --build
scripts.compose:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile postgres --profile mssql down --remove-orphans
